Folks — forwarding Jordan's invite. When customers forward an org-generated .ics into our hosted calendar in the past we've seen two problems: (1) external attendees show as 'not a guest' and can't RSVP, and (2) organizer metadata points at the original domain which sometimes prevents SSO-provisioned guests from joining Meet.

Quick plan: I'll recreate an invite from our side using a Zoom bridge and send it to Jordan + their scheduling alias. Priyom, can you generate a lightweight .ics from Zoom and include the join link? Jonas, please stand by in case we need to change organizer to scheduling@aurelia.com and resend from their address (we'll need a delegated access flow).

Ask: Priyom — can you make the Zoom invite but do NOT forward the customer's .ics into it (that's the repro step). Create a fresh event and attach the new .ics.

I've attached a screenshot showing the calendar view — you can see the duplicate entries and the gray (unaccepted) state for a couple of attendees.
